posts.title: Corn Maze 2026
posts.description: I launched the Corn Maze app for the Crow River Winery for 2026 (year 4) in September. There was no corn maze in 2025, but I’m happy to have it back this year.

posts.title: 3D Printed Server Rack
posts.description: For starters, let’s get one thing out of the way. Had I planned carefully the rack could have looked a lot better and fit my hardware better. I found this project , got excited about it, and just started printing parts, then, tried to put them together. Then I just did some iterating, until I finally ended up with something functional and a lot uglier than it could have been.
